terms.context: A single note the user adds to a block in the document
terms.notes: Never 'примітка' or 'коментар'; 'нотатка' is used consistently throughout, including in status messages such as «Нотатку додано»

terms.context: A paragraph, list item, heading, table row or code block that a note attaches to
terms.notes: Used generically for any commentable unit ('перейти від блоку до блоку', 'блок коду', 'меню блоку')

terms.context: The panel listing every note in the file; also the 'Notes list' menu command and section heading
terms.notes: Consistent across the View menu command, the section heading and status messages ('Список нотаток 40%', 'Список нотаток приховано')

terms.context: The bar at the bottom of the window that shows confirmation messages such as 'Note added'
The bar at the top of the window holding File/Edit/View/Notes/Help
Assistive technology, as in the 'Using a screen reader' section heading
terms.notes: Rendered as a descriptive phrase ('program for reading from the screen'), not a loanword like 'скринридер' or 'програма зчитування екрана'; declines by case as needed ('вашою програмою читання з екрана')

terms.context: The text pair (default [usernote]/[/usernote]) that wraps a note in the Markdown file
terms.notes: Also 'Відкривальний маркер' / 'Закривальний маркер' for the Opening marker / Closing marker settings

terms.context: A Markdown checklist item, as in the confirmation 'Mark this task as done?'
terms.notes: Confirmation text: «Позначити це завдання як виконане? Файл на диску буде змінено.»

terms.context: The setting controlling what language PlanCake assumes the open document is written in
The setting controlling the language of PlanCake's own menus, dialogs and messages
Generic word for a dialog box, e.g. the Open dialog or a confirmation dialog
terms.notes: Masculine noun ('діалог «Відкрити»', 'стандартний діалог відкриття Windows', 'Enter у діалозі нотатки'); 'вікно' is only the main window, never a dialog

terms.context: Confirmation dialog buttons, e.g. for deleting a note or marking a task done
Windows Explorer, as the source of dragged or copied files
The Windows Downloads folder where files opened from a link are saved
terms.notes: The folder's name as Windows shows it, in « » because it does not decline with 'папка' ('до вашої папки «Завантаження»')

terms.context: Any folder on disk, e.g. the userdata folder of the portable version
terms.notes: The word Ukrainian Windows uses; never 'тека'

terms.context: Windows Start menu, used to launch PlanCake
terms.notes: The menu's name in « », as with every name after a generic noun: меню «Файл», кнопка «Скасувати», діалог «Додати нотатку»

terms.context: cmd.exe, as distinct from PowerShell
File Explorer's command that copies a quoted file path to the clipboard
A GitHub issue, as in 'Paste them into a new issue on PlanCake's GitHub page'
terms.notes: Rendered as 'нове звернення' (a general-purpose word for a report/inquiry), not a calque like 'тікет' or literal 'проблема'

terms.context: GitHub's 'Raw' link/button for viewing a file's raw contents
terms.notes: Left untranslated, in Latin script, as it names GitHub's own UI label
